paraphrase: Describes a built completion-signal system: task receipts as JSON files (task ID, start/end timestamps, success boolean, output hash, error message), completion signals to completed/ and failed/ directories (append-only), Trello sync.

claims.text: Task receipts should contain: task_id, started_at/ended_at, success boolean, output_path, output_hash (SHA-256), error_message
claims.notes: Implemented JSON structure; failures include stack traces truncated to 4KB

claims.text: Receipts are append-only and logs are read-only forensics, not operational awareness
